Implement an in-memory invitation registry in `Solution.java`. Define nested public record `Invite(String sender, String recipient)` and public enum `Decision { ACCEPTED, DECLINED }`. Expose public static methods `void clear()`, `boolean send(String sender, String recipient)`, `boolean decide(String sender, String recipient, Decision decision)`, `List<Invite> receivedBy(String recipient)`, and `boolean connected(String first, String second)`. Identifiers are normalized by trimming and converting to lowercase with `Locale.ROOT`; null or empty identifiers are malformed and must cause `IllegalArgumentException`. Self-invitations are rejected by returning false. `send` returns false if the users are already connected or if an invitation exists in either direction. `decide` returns false if the directed invitation does not exist; otherwise it removes it and, when accepted, creates a symmetric connection. Received invitations are returned in ascending sender order as a new unmodifiable list. `connected(x,x)` is always false. No returned collection may expose mutable internal state. Implement a new standard-library-only solution.
